integrity: All-dimensional proof supplied; two standalone checkers validate the finite base and bounded consistency cases. All source code and run instructions embedded; no external mathematical verification or independent audit has been performed.
limitations: For antipodal shortest paths only, at most two internal vertex failures; no sharp rerouting distance bound; unresolved risk of unindexed equivalent. Dimension-four base is computationally exhaustive, larger dimensions are proved inductively.
title: Two-vertex fault tolerance of antipodal hypercube geodesic rerouting
